name: KFin Technologies Ltd
title: KFin Technologies Ltd - 543720 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Registrar with mature MF franchise; Q4 revenue +23% YoY (4.6% ex-Ascent), EBITDA margin 37% in quarter vs 40.7% FY; FY27 base case 23-24% revenue, EBITDA 16-17%, PAT ~10%, explicitly not formal guidance.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +23% YoY, ex-Ascent +4.6%
triggers.quote: for the same quarter versus last year, it has grown by about 23%. If you look at excluding Ascent, it has grown for the same quarter versus last year by 4.6%.

triggers.label: AUM +21% vs revenue +11%
triggers.quote: Overall, our AUM has grown in line with the industry at about 21%, but that, of course, did not necessarily translate into revenues as they grown only about a little over 11%.

triggers.label: Equity mix shift to passives hits yield
triggers.quote: the asset mix for us for equity has come down by 200 basis points into the last 2 quarters.

triggers.label: Existing folios lost 1.7m
triggers.quote: all the existing clients will be lost over 1.7 million folios, right?

triggers.label: FY27 base case: rev 23-24%, EBITDA 16-17%
triggers.quote: we have a reasonable line of visibility to get to about 23% to 24% top line growth into the coming year.

triggers.label: April AUM up ~2.5% MoM, early ETF reversal
triggers.quote: if I look at April for us, we have seen a 2.5% thereabouts increase month-over-month.

guidance.metric: FY27 revenue growth (consolidated, not formal guidance)
guidance.quote: we believe that we have a reasonable line of visibility to get to about 23% to 24% top line growth into the coming year.
EBITDA, we expect it to be around 16% to 17% and a PAT little around 10% growth is what we expect to see into the coming year.
We still have a very strong visibility to 40% EBITDA into this year
we are looking at a pretty robust international revenue -- the organic revenue to grow a little over 60% plus into this year
our goal to reduce the dependency on the domestic mutual funds to be below 50%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Including Ascent, we have maintained 40.7% EBITDA margin, which is a guidance we have been giving
we are at 27.1% on a consolidated basis. Without Ascent, we were at almost 30% margin, which is the guidance of 27% to 30%

red_flags.label: Mark-to-market and passive mix eroding yield
red_flags.quote: the asset mix for us for equity has come down by 200 basis points into the last 2 quarters.

red_flags.label: Net folio erosion ~2m in FY26
red_flags.quote: There has been a net erosion of close to -- almost 2 million folios in this year.

red_flags.label: Guidance caveated as not formal
red_flags.quote: Now this isn't necessarily a guidance, but as much as, I guess, our bottom -up projections internally

evasions.quote: those are drop out of time, which are not exactly precise numbers. We are still aiming to cross 40% into this year.
I do not believe it was ever at 9 basis points thereabout.
